title: MRC restore boot mode chosen from SbWarmResetVar alone
description: MRC sets restore boot mode +220CC=1 whenever the NVRAM variable SbWarmResetVar (GUID B8CAFA84-4593-4AA9-AEF7-8E686EB07320) exists, without SBPEI's value (RWsI) and capsule-PPI checks. On that path MRC loads MemoryConfig* and skips the cold-training tasks. PchReset creates the variable only on a warm ResetSystem while CapsuleUpdateData exists; SBDXE deletes it later. A capsule cycle interrupted before SBDXE runs would leave every boot on the restore path, even across AC drain and CMOS clear.
not_established: The live board has neither variable and fwupd has no history. PR9's MRC lacks this read, so it does not explain the shared failure.
remediation: Require SBPEI's value and the capsule checks before choosing restore mode. No candidate.
